Album.description: One row per music album, linking each album title to its single performing artist; used as the grouping level between artists and tracks.

Artist.description: One row per recording artist or band, providing the canonical artist name referenced by albums.

Customer.description: One row per customer account holding contact and location details, with the assigned support representative; used for sales and customer analysis.

columns.Company: Company name for business customers; 'None' (null) for individuals
columns.State: State or province code (e.g. 'SP', 'QC', 'AB'); 'None' (null) where not applicable
columns.PostalCode: Postal or ZIP code in the customer's local format
columns.SupportRepId: EmployeeId of the employee assigned as this customer's support representative

Employee.description: One row per staff member with job title, reporting line, and contact details; used for org and sales-rep analysis.

columns.Title: Job title (e.g. 'General Manager', 'Sales Support Agent')
columns.ReportsTo: EmployeeId of this employee's manager; null for the top of the hierarchy
columns.BirthDate: Date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (time always 00:00:00)
columns.HireDate: Date the employee was hired, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (time always 00:00:00)
columns.State: State or province code; null where not applicable

Genre.description: One row per music genre (e.g. Rock, Jazz, Metal), used to categorize tracks.

Invoice.description: One row per sales invoice (order header) for a customer, storing billing address and the invoice total; used for revenue and sales analysis.

columns.InvoiceDate: Invoice timestamp, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (time always 00:00:00)
columns.BillingAddress: Billing address on the invoice, copied from the customer at the time of purchase; may differ from the customer's current address
columns.BillingState: Billing state or province code; null where not applicable
columns.Total: Invoice total in the billing currency (sum of its line items)

InvoiceLine.description: One row per track purchased within an invoice, giving the unit price and quantity; the detail level for sales analysis.

columns.UnitPrice: Price charged per unit of the track at time of sale
columns.Quantity: Number of units of the track purchased on this line

MediaType.description: One row per media format (e.g. MPEG audio, protected AAC, MPEG-4 video) that a track can be stored in.

columns.Name: Media format name; 'Protected' indicates DRM-restricted files

Playlist.description: One row per named playlist, a user-curated collection of tracks.

PlaylistTrack.description: Junction table, one row per track included in a playlist; links Playlist and Track in a many-to-many relationship.

Track.description: One row per individual track (song or video), with its album, media type, genre, length, file size and unit price; the core catalog table.

columns.AlbumId: Album this track belongs to; null if the track is not part of an album
columns.GenreId: Genre of the track; null if unassigned
columns.Composer: Composer credit(s), comma-separated; null if unknown
columns.Bytes: Size of the media file in bytes; null if unknown
columns.UnitPrice: Price per unit of the track in the billing currency
